articles.title: North Korea denies links to Binance hack as researchers trace stolen billions
articles.description: North Korea rejected allegations linking it to the Binance hack as blockchain researchers traced billions in stolen cryptocurrency across networks.

articles.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
articles.description: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance’s own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn’t said when it will refill it.

articles.title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
articles.description: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.

articles.title: Crypto.com to withdraw Hong Kong consumer app citing regulatory changes
articles.description: Crypto.com will discontinue its consumer app services in Hong Kong in February next year.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops below $77,000 as chip rout deepens ahead of U.S. midterm vote
articles.description: ZEC tumbled nearly 10% and BNB fell under $700 as the Nasdaq 100 slid into a correction, dragging Asian stocks lower.

articles.title: U.S. reportedly strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Vance hopes for ‘negotiated settlement’ with Tehran
articles.description: U.S. military carried out attacks on Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday, even as the Trump administration has been underplaying war risks.

articles.title: Australia lifts rates to 18-year high as AI boom, energy costs fuel inflation

articles.title: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028

articles.title: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation
articles.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia's decision was in line with expectations from economists polled by Reuters, and marked its fifth rate increase this year.

articles.title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase, exchange outflows slow

articles.title: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack
